budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed an Accounts Payable warrant and a school construction warrant with the amounts printed.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $181,604.51 and a school construction warrant in the amount of $2,543,308.05.

budget_items.topic: License fee comparison with other towns
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Toale's calculations put Lunenburg's license fees behind the highest-fee towns by a printed amount and behind the average by a smaller printed amount.
budget_items.quote: if we compare our fees to the highest fees, we would be $35,000 behind. if we were to compare ourselves to the average fees, we would run $5,000 behind.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Common victualer licenses were the most issued and carried a printed fee; the Town could charge up to a printed higher amount.
budget_items.quote: the most licenses issued were common victualer (35) and were $25.00. she added the town would be able to charge up $100 for a common victualer license.
